description: A single-panel figure rendered as a two-column, six-row data table (no axes, no micrograph, no scale bar). The left column header is printed in bold italic as "Hyper-parameters" and the right column header as "Best combination"; a horizontal rule separates the header row from the body. Each body row pairs one hyper-parameter name with a single numeric value, reproduced exactly as printed: n_estimators = 1657; max_depth = 51; min_samples_split = 3; min_samples_leaf = 1.0; max_features = 0.85; max_samples = 0.92. No units or error bars accompany any entry, and no other columns (e.g. search range, sensitivity, or validation score) are present. The caption identifies this as Table 2, "Optimal hyper-parameters configuration", and the citing text states that these values are the optimised model hyper-parameters obtained through a genetic algorithm (GA) search over six key parameters built on the DEAP 1.3.3 framework, with population size 30, crossover and mutation probabilities of 0.7 and 0.3, and convergence after the 26th of 30 generations. The figure therefore documents the tuned configuration of the machine-learning regression model used for yield-strength prediction; it demonstrates the specific parameter set adopted, not a material property or a measured response.

observations.observation: The figure is a single two-column table whose column headers read 'Hyper-parameters' (bold italic, left) and 'Best combination' (bold italic, right).
The table lists exactly six hyper-parameter rows: n_estimators, max_depth, min_samples_split, min_samples_leaf, max_features and max_samples.
Printed value for max_depth is 51 and for min_samples_split is 3.
Printed value for min_samples_leaf is 1.0, given as a decimal rather than an integer.
Printed values for max_features and max_samples are 0.85 and 0.92 respectively, both expressed as fractions.
The table gives no units, uncertainty, search range, or reference/default column for any entry.
The caption states this is Table 2, 'Optimal hyper-parameters configuration'.
The citing text states the search space comprised six key parameters (including n_estimators, max_depth and min_samples_split) built on the DEAP 1.3.3 framework.
The citing text states the GA used a hybrid encoding strategy, mixed crossover with Gaussian mutation, and an elitism strategy.

The citing text states population size 30, crossover and mutation probabilities of 0.7 and 0.3, and evolution over 30 generations with convergence after the 26th generation; none of these numbers appear in the table itself.
The citing text states these are the optimized Extra Trees model hyper-parameters obtained through the GA, identifying the model family that the table configures.
